comments.author: NotAnAlt
comments.body: Anyone knows how these recipe show up? Is it random monthly or is there anything you need to do to unlock them?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
My understanding is that monthly recipes appear at Lorenzo. Other (permanent) recipes appear at his maids, each of whom specializes in a production category.

However, the monthly recipes feature items like Macarons; recipes involving the use of High/Highest grade gemstones are considered permanent. This recipe book seems a little mixed up.
